title: Discovering Dual-Origin Slow Wind from Solar Orbiter with Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.22065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whether the slow solar wind originates from one coronal source or two distinct channels remains a central open question in heliophysics. Resolving this requires unsupervised separation of two populations that arrive at nearly the same bulk speed and differ mainly in heavy-ion composition. We present Solar-CDC, a self-supervised contrastive deep clustering (CDC) framework that maps plasma observables to a latent space via a Transformer encoder, optimizes a triplet margin loss, and updates pseudo-labels via $k$-means. Theoretically, we prove that neighborhood-preserving embeddings such as t-SNE and UMAP are fundamentally constrained. Preserving the neighbor graph leaves the cross-cluster cut fraction unchanged, and preserving all but a fraction $\varepsilon$ of its links moves that fraction by at most $\varepsilon$. Neither bound depends on the target dimension. A margin objective rewrites the graph and drives the cut fraction to zero. E

translated_title: 利用自监督对比学习从太阳轨道器发现双起源慢太阳风
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22065v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：慢太阳风是否源自一个日冕源或两个不同通道，仍是太阳物理学中的一个核心未解问题。解决这一问题需要对两个以几乎相同整体速度到达、主要差异在于重离子组成的群体进行无监督分离。我们提出了Solar-CDC，一种自监督对比深度聚类（CDC）框架，通过Transformer编码器将等离子体可观测数据映射到潜在空间，优化三元组边际损失，并通过$k$-均值更新伪标签。理论上，我们证明了诸如t-SNE和UMAP等保持邻域的嵌入方法存在根本性限制。保持邻域图会使跨簇切割比例不变，而保持除$\varepsilon$比例外的所有链接会使该比例最多改变$\varepsilon$。这两个界限都不依赖于目标维度。边际目标重写图并将切割比例降至零。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种自监督对比深度聚类框架（Solar-CDC），能够有效分离慢太阳风中两个来源不同的等离子体群体，并通过理论证明揭示了传统邻域保持嵌入方法的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Solar-CDC, a self-supervised contrastive deep clustering framework that effectively separates two distinct slow solar wind populations, and theoretically demonstrates the limitations of conventional neighborhood-preserving embeddings.
